providers.title: AI providers
providers.subtitle: Built-in providers are free. You can pick your own models and add any OpenAI-compatible API. The app switches between them automatically when limits run out.
providers.tip: Tip: add keys from 2–3 different providers so one limit never stops you. Gemini limits are per Google project, so several keys from one project add no quota.

desc.gemini: Best quality, understands images. Free key in Google AI Studio.
desc.groq: Very fast with generous free limits; vision-capable models available.
desc.openrouter: Dozens of free (:free) models with one key. Great backup.
desc.mistral: Free Experiment tier; models understand images.
desc.cerebras: Ultra-fast text models with a large daily token budget.

guide.title: Guide
guide.subtitle: Three steps to your first answer

steps.title: 1. Get free keys
steps.body: Open “AI providers” and press “Get a key” next to Gemini, Groq or OpenRouter. Sign-up is free, no card required. The more different providers, the more reliable it gets.

steps.title: 2. Open the test in the app browser
steps.body: Press “Open browser” — a separate Chrome/Edge profile with scanning support starts. Sign in to the test site (logins persist between launches).

steps.title: 3. Scan
steps.body: Press “Scan”, F8 or Ctrl+Enter in the app window, or choose “Scan” in the tray menu. The answer appears in the app and in a Windows notification.

steps.title: Modes
steps.body: Auto — text + screenshot (most accurate). Text — fastest. Screenshot — when the question is an image or formula.

steps.title: Troubleshooting
steps.body: “Browser not running” — close all Chrome windows and press “Open browser”. “Out of quota” — add a key from another provider. Logs: Settings → Open logs.
